problem_statement: The order placement loop crashes as soon as an order lands in the warning band (80-100% of the position limit). Instead of being placed and written to the review log, the run aborts with `ValueError: audit notifier only carries critical alerts, got warning` and the rest of the request queue is never processed. This started after the review routing was consolidated in `ComplianceCheck.route_report`. `tests/test_pipeline.py::test_order_near_limit_is_placed_and_logged` reproduces it. Please fix it so warning-band orders are placed and logged without taking down the loop.
